title: ReservationCancelled
description: The data of the event reservation.ReservationCancelled.v1: a reservation was cancelled, and its room is free for its period. A consumer ignores the properties that it does not know.

roomId.description: The id of the room that the reservation held, as the Facility API knows it.

startsAt.description: When the cancelled reservation would have started.

endsAt.description: When the cancelled reservation would have ended.

organizerEmail.description: The email address of the person who organized the meeting.
